hooks.text: Ten billion light-years across, a cosmic wall exists that shouldn't.
Astronomers found a structure spanning ten percent of the observable universe.
Ten billion light-years of galaxies sit where our models forbid them.

title: The Cosmic Wall That Shouldn't Exist
description: Discover the Hercules-Corona Borealis Great Wall, a titanic ten-billion-light-year structure that challenges our understanding of the universe.

beats.text: Ten billion light-years across, a cosmic wall exists that shouldn't.
beats.visual: Observable universe logarithmic scale map illustrating large scale structure
queries: Universe large scale structure galaxy filaments

beats.text: In November twenty-thirteen, astronomers István Horváth, Jon Hakkila, and Zsolt Bagoly analyzed gamma-ray bursts using data from space telescopes.
beats.visual: NASA Swift Gamma-Ray Burst Explorer satellite model illustration in space
queries: Swift Gamma Ray Burst Explorer satellite model illustration

beats.text: Because these explosions are extremely luminous and track massive star formations, researchers used them to map unseen matter.
beats.visual: Artist concept of a gamma-ray burst and supernova jet
queries: Supernova gamma ray jet artist concept

beats.text: They mapped the Hercules-Corona Borealis Great Wall spanning about ten percent of the entire observable universe.
beats.visual: Cosmic web large scale structure simulation diagram
queries: Universe large scale structure galaxy filaments

beats.text: This structure shatters the cosmological principle, which states the universe should be uniform on large scales.
beats.visual: Artist illustration of a distant galaxy supercluster and cosmic filaments

beats.text: Jon Hakkila admitted that he would have thought this structure was too big to exist.
beats.visual: Constellation Hercules star map and night sky

beats.text: Some studies argue it could simply be a statistical illusion in incomplete datasets.
beats.visual: Cosmic web simulation diagram showing observational density variations
queries: Universe large scale structure galaxy filaments

beats.text: Until future missions decide the debate, ten billion light-years of galaxies remain an impossible anomaly.
beats.visual: Observable universe scale map logarithmic illustrating distant cosmic structures
